domainContext: Product for companies which produces and manage Movie, Drama, Documentaries from Planning to Release.
summaryGuidelines:
Include:
1. Keep it self-explanatory (understandable without context).
2. Use present tense.
3. Try hard for a simplest form.
4. Clearly describe what is wrong, not how to fix it.
6. Mention condition/context if needed.
7. Short, clear, self-explanatory description.

Avoid:
1. Avoid vague words like issue, problem, bug.
descriptionGuidelines:
Include :
Steps to reproduce -
•Use action-based steps
•Start with navigation
•Keep concise, no unnecessary steps
•Use “Navigate”, “Click”, “Enter”, “Observe” like keywords
Expected Result -
•Describe correct system behavior
•Keep it clear and direct
Actual Result -
•Describe what is happening incorrectly
•Avoid assumptions
Business/UX Impact -
•Impactful sentence 
•User confusion
•Data inconsistency
•Workflow disruption
•UX inconsistency
extraInstructions:
Avoid
•Vague summaries
•Mixing multiple issues in one ticket
•Long paragraphs in steps
•Technical assumptions (unless confirmed)
•Avoid Words like: something, issue, not working properly
•Avoid long explanations
